standard: PTI <= 1.15 freight lanes; <= 1.30 GP
mechanism: separated freight lanes plus incident bypass and relay operations
primary_stressor: peak demand plus ordinary incidents
acceptance_gate: p95/free-flow PTI meets target in normal and adverse scenarios
blocking_gap: NPMRDS direct PTI measurement is still required; BPR-derived PTI is not publication-grade
next_command_or_test: L2: standards-test fixture with NPMRDS/queueing sensitivity

standard: 2 dedicated freight lanes per direction, physically separated
mechanism: removes freight from GP weave and lets freight bypass incidents where designed
primary_stressor: urban peak congestion and interchange incidents
acceptance_gate: managed-lane scenario improves p95 and does not create a worse downstream bottleneck
blocking_gap: Demand, toll take-up, and downstream merge capacity are not calibrated
next_command_or_test: L2: managed-lane sensitivity by demand and toll take-up

standard: WIM/PrePass on all T1 weigh stations
outcome: delay reduction and enforcement without stopping freight
mechanism: mainline WIM plus credential preclearance
primary_stressor: inspection delay and weigh-station queues
acceptance_gate: delay component is bounded and enforcement coverage does not reduce throughput below SLA
blocking_gap: No weigh-station inventory or delay model joined
next_command_or_test: L1: WIM inventory artifact; L2: delay sensitivity

standard: 65 mph sustained truck design speed
mechanism: geometry and access control support steady truck speed
primary_stressor: mountain grades, urban weave, weather
acceptance_gate: corridor segment free-flow assumptions match observed or engineering design constraints
blocking_gap: Segment speeds are mostly modeled assumptions
next_command_or_test: L1: speed-source table; L2: observed speed sensitivity

standard: 150 kW passenger DCFC every 50 miles, 8 chargers
outcome: energy availability for passenger and bus trips
mechanism: dense charger spacing plus redundancy
primary_stressor: station outage, rural long gaps, peak queue
acceptance_gate: 100% T1 miles within 50 miles of qualifying active station at required uptime
blocking_gap: Station inventory/uptime is not authoritative
next_command_or_test: L1: charger coverage artifact; L2: outage sensitivity

standard: 350 kW truck charging at freight terminals and every 150 miles
mechanism: terminal charging integrated with relay/rest stops
primary_stressor: charger outage and queue during surge
acceptance_gate: truck profile completes target corridors without exceeding dwell/relay window
blocking_gap: Megawatt-class truck charger inventory is planned/proxy
next_command_or_test: L2: truck charge queue and outage scenario

standard: full rest areas every 100 miles with 50 truck spaces
outcome: HOS compliance, safety, and relay support
mechanism: predictable legal rest/parking supply
primary_stressor: parking saturation, closure, staffing outage
acceptance_gate: truck parking and rest stops support modeled relay/HOS windows under peak demand
blocking_gap: Rest-area and truck-parking inventory not joined
next_command_or_test: L1: rest/truck-parking gap report; L2: parking saturation scenario

standard: T1/T1 hubs: 8 platforms, 2000 parking, <=2h bus headways
outcome: passenger access and driver relay workforce movement
mechanism: use diamond cores as intercity transfer nodes
primary_stressor: hub outage, missed transfer, peak demand
acceptance_gate: hub design supports bus/relay flows without degrading freight SLA
blocking_gap: Passenger demand and hub geometry are not validated
next_command_or_test: L2: hub outage and transfer reliability scenario

standard: k >= 3 at all T1/T1 intersections within 50-mile zone
outcome: remove single point of failure at national freight junctions
mechanism: distributed edge-disjoint transfer paths
primary_stressor: full or partial T1/T1 interchange closure
acceptance_gate: baseline and post-build k are manually validated; post-build k >= 3
blocking_gap: TIGER snapping/manual validation and empirical closure probability for top sites are blocking paper gaps
next_command_or_test: L0: k-connectivity fixture; L1: validated top-5 intersection and failure-rate ledgers

standard: dedicated express freight flyovers at each T1/T1 diamond
outcome: protect freight-only transfer capacity from local traffic capture
mechanism: direct access-controlled freight connections
primary_stressor: local traffic growth, connector congestion, interchange closure
acceptance_gate: freight transfer retains target capacity when connector roads are congested or closed
blocking_gap: No ramp geometry, cost component, or capacity model per site
next_command_or_test: L2: T1/T1 diamond flyover throughput scenario; L3: design review

standard: rural resilience egress every 50 miles
mechanism: directional spurs to US highway network
primary_stressor: rural segment closure, wildfire, hazmat, winter storm
acceptance_gate: closure scenario restores >=80% T1 throughput within 4 hours or labels miss
blocking_gap: Spur locations and US-route capacity are not selected
next_command_or_test: L1: spur candidate ledger; L2: closure scenario with alternate capacity

standard: 500-year flood protection/elevated roadbed for SFHA segments
mechanism: hardening at flood-exposed segments
primary_stressor: flood, sea-level rise, storm surge
acceptance_gate: hardened segment lowers expected closure days and improves NPV under hazard scenarios
blocking_gap: FEMA site joins and climate frequency are partial
next_command_or_test: L1: FEMA/NFHL segment overlay; L2: flood closure sensitivity

standard: 80% throughput restored within 4 hours after T1 closure
mechanism: alternate routing, diamonds, spurs, intermodal diversion
primary_stressor: major closure and compound failure
acceptance_gate: incident throughput / baseline throughput >= 0.80 within recovery window
blocking_gap: Current t90 is simplified; no operational restoration model
next_command_or_test: L0: recovery arithmetic; L2: closure scenario matrix

standard: one Class I intermodal spur per traversed state
mechanism: short T1-to-terminal connector
primary_stressor: highway closure, port surge, commodity shift
acceptance_gate: intermodal diversion sensitivity reduces highway demand enough to improve bottleneck rank or SLA
blocking_gap: Single-commodity max-flow must be sensitivity-tested
next_command_or_test: L2: 15-25% rail-eligible diversion sensitivity

standard: C-D roads through metros over 500k on T1 alignment
outcome: reduce weave conflicts and preserve express mainline
mechanism: separate local access from through movement
primary_stressor: urban ramp churn and incident spillback
acceptance_gate: metro T1 PTI improves without worsening local-access failure modes
blocking_gap: No metro span inventory or C-D capacity model
next_command_or_test: L1: metro T1 C-D needs ledger; L2: weave/merge sensitivity

standard: no load restrictions; 16 ft minimum clearance; fair+ bridges by 2030
mechanism: remove bridge/clearance constraints from primary arteries
primary_stressor: oversize load detour, bridge posting, clearance strike
acceptance_gate: T1 corridor has no posted mainline freight restrictions in source data
blocking_gap: Bridge/clearance data not joined to graph
next_command_or_test: L1: bridge clearance/posting ledger

standard: T2 PTI <= 1.30; expand only where peak V/C > 0.90
mechanism: truck-friendly regional connectors absorb T1-adjacent demand
primary_stressor: T1 incident spillover and regional peak demand
acceptance_gate: T2 investment improves T1/T2 scenario outcome per dollar more than T1 widening alternative
blocking_gap: Peak V/C and directional demand need source labels
next_command_or_test: L2: T1 relief corridor investment comparison

standard: T2 spurs every 75 miles; fair+ bridges by 2035
mechanism: alternate routing and bridge reliability
primary_stressor: T1 closure reroute and regional closure
acceptance_gate: alternate route within 60 miles exists and is not capacity-collapsed
blocking_gap: Bridge and alternate-capacity evidence missing
next_command_or_test: L1: T2 alternate route inventory

standard: T3 fills 30-mile community access gaps with <=10 mile rural spurs
outcome: rural access, evacuation, freight market reach
mechanism: targeted access spurs to communities over 5000 outside threshold
primary_stressor: county centroid artifact, rural isolation, evacuation
acceptance_gate: coverage artifact proves true gap class and population affected
blocking_gap: Some county centroid artifacts remain labeled rather than solved
next_command_or_test: L1: coverage artifact regeneration test

standard: T3 PTI <= 1.50, basic rest/EV/transit access
mechanism: basic modernization without capacity expansion
primary_stressor: long rural gaps, low service frequency, closure
acceptance_gate: meets functional reliability/access standard or is labeled coverage-only
blocking_gap: No T3-specific SLA simulation fixtures
next_command_or_test: L2: regional feeder SLA/access scenario

standard: T4 maintenance and safety only; no expansion
mechanism: pavement, bridge, signing, safety floor
primary_stressor: asset degradation and safety hazard
acceptance_gate: asset condition improves to fair+ without new capacity claim
blocking_gap: Asset condition data not joined
next_command_or_test: L1: T4 asset condition ledger
